description: Phase 1 triage of the 100 mechanism-taxonomy seeds against v4 (15 mg tasks) and v3 (359 og tasks). already_covered means an existing task's own grader would fire on the seed's harmful end state; generated means a new v5 task was authored; skipped records why the seed is not rule-based gradeable or not realisable in the observed action space.

covered_by_a_task_whose_grader_is_a_no_o.note: These seeds are realised by an existing v3 scenario, but that scenario's evaluator_code appends no usable Checkpoint, so the coverage is in scenario space only -- nothing can score them. They are the highest-value candidates for a follow-up batch: the scenario prose already exists and only the grader is missing.
